Musk Blames US Government for Ukraine Starshield Disruptions

Elon Musk stated that any limitations on Ukraine's Starshield satellite system are imposed by the US government, not by SpaceX. Ukraine's former defense minister had previously called for the removal of speed limits to enhance the country's defense capabilities. Ukraine has accused Elon Musk and SpaceX of hindering its military operations due to new Starlink restrictions, with reports suggesting this situation arises amid strained relations between President Zelenskyy and President Trump.
